title: feat(core, objectql, metadata, metadata-protocol, plugin-security): a permission-set name is held once per namespace, judged by one predicate (ADR-0150 child B)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuQSK2tpXYSs4MGfsh8fnJM5)_
Fixes #31698

Clause-②: yes (widening) — two packages of two namespaces may each hold a permission set of one name, each granted, cloned, activated and read by its own (package, name); co-owners of one namespace, a package with no namespace, a holder in a shareable platform namespace (`base`, `system`, `sys`), the platform-requested `guest_portal`, the environment's own set and a built-in name keep one holder, refused with today's envelope and sentence.
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts (the `name` describe still reads "unique within the security catalog the environment serves"); skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md already teaches that permission sets are identified by package and name

**Narrowing: no** — per ruling 6764881683 and the epic read 6764938596 (#31973's precedent): first-party co-owner pairs **0**, cross-namespace pairs **0** (step-0 census at `45f0f81f`; re-counted statically on this head: crm ships `crm_*` and `guest_portal`, showcase ships `showcase_*`, todo and multi-package ship none). Every refusal that stays is unchanged in envelope and sentence.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：permission set 的名字从「整个环境只能一个包持有」放宽到「每个命名空间一个包」。两个不同命名空间的包可以各发同名的权限集，授予、克隆、激活、读取各按 (包, 名字) 走；同命名空间的共有者、没有命名空间的包、`base`/`system`/`sys` 平台命名空间里的持有者、`guest_portal`、环境自己的集和内置名照旧只许一个持有者。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D2/D9，史诗 #31527 子卡 B 的权限集族；E/G/S 各子卡（#32160、#32162、#32164）已落地，这里打开开关，并先补齐两持有者状态下会出错的读写（目录、锁、回声、集群删除、过期授予）。
- 风险与回滚：第一方同名对 0；两持有者时，不带包的读、授予、克隆、激活答 409 并点名两边，不带包列的授予什么都不给。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/permission-set-holders.ts`（唯一谓词），`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `securityCatalogHoldersOtherThan`，`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-catalog-echo.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol-permission-set-name-registry-reading.test.ts`，预期 17/17 通过，其中 CONTROL `crm + hr` 三道门都放行，`sys + crm`、`base + crm`、`guest_portal` 三道门都拒绝。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（第 1 问 row 9 已由你裁定 A，6824698376；按序在 #32718 合入后落地）。

## What changes

`permissionSetHoldersMeet` (`@objectstack/core`) is the ONE predicate that judges two package holders of a permission-set name. The registry's package door, its item seam and the metadata save door (`permissionSetNameCollisionRefusal`) all ask it; nothing else spells it. The registry's claim for a name becomes a set of claimants.

| What | FROM (`main`) | TO (this PR) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Install of a package of another namespace declaring a permission-set name a package holds | refused, `SecurityCatalogNameConflictError` | installed; both claims kept, each released by its own uninstall |
| A package of another namespace registering a set of that name at the item seam | refused | registered |
| Save, publish or restore of a set of that name into a package of another namespace | `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` | saved |
| `sys` + `crm`, `crm` + `sys`, `base` + `crm` (either order, holder enabled or disabled) | refused | refused, unchanged |
| `guest_portal` held by `crm`, arriving from `hr` | refused | refused, unchanged |
| A package with no namespace beside `crm`; co-owners of one namespace; the environment's own set; a built-in name | refused | refused, unchanged |
| Bare read, grant, clone or activation of a name two packages hold, naming no package | (unreachable) | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both (#32162, #32164); a grant with no `permission_set_package` confers nothing |

**The difference from the sibling `namespacedHoldersMeet`** (N3 condition 2), measured on the predicates themselves and pinned at all three doors:

| pair | sibling `namespacedHoldersMeet` | `permissionSetHoldersMeet` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crm` + `hr` (CONTROL) | do not meet: both admitted | do not meet: both admitted |
| `sys` + `crm` | do not meet | meet: refused, unchanged |
| `base` + `crm` | do not meet | meet: refused, unchanged |
| `guest_portal`, `crm` + `hr` | do not meet | meet: refused, unchanged |
| no namespace + `crm` | meet | meet: refused, unchanged |

Owed rows closed before two holders of one name can exist (each carried on #31698):

- **6776956342 row 1** — the security catalog reads a set two packages' metadata-service slots hold as a refusal naming both; a stored column reads its own package's slot.
- **row 2** — the packaged-set lock names every package that declares the name; its registry-less read goes to each holder.
- **row 3 and epic note 6776737317** — the security-catalog echo is kept per package: a permission projector event names the package its row landed in, every other echo slot is judged by its own row, a gone slot is removed from memory only.
- **row 4** — closed on `main` already (#32244's `packageScopedRefusalOf` in both catches; #32566).
- **6781866663 R1** — a binding read that fails keeps the package the existing slot names.
- **the package-less watcher `deleted`** — `MetadataManager.unregisterInMemory` drops one registry slot and deletes from no loader; a peer that hears a removal naming a package drops that package's slot only.
- **the stale-slot drop removing storage** — the echo never deletes a stored row.
- **N1 / N2 / N3** — the save-door collision refusal asks the predicate; the registry claim is a set; one predicate, both doors.
- **6816011109 row 9** — pinned through this PR's doors (see Tests).
- A grant whose package no longer serves its set confers nothing where another grant of the same user, set and organization is bound to the holder it reads; the bound grant and its validity window grant that set (`staleGrantBesideBoundGrant`, one rule read by the authorization resolver and the catalog reference boot report).

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-permission-set-name-registry-reading.test.ts` — one predicate, three doors over the real composition (`ObjectQLPlugin` + real protocol + `SchemaRegistry`): CONTROL `crm + hr` admitted at all three; `sys + crm`, `crm + sys`, `base + crm`, `guest_portal`, no-namespace refused at all three; the predicate table against the sibling; the shared namespaces equal the registry's shareable ones; two admitted claims each released by their own uninstall.
- **Row 9 (N3 condition 3), against `main` at this merge (`5f84ef0e`):** a second holder beside a `sys` holder is refused at every door in both orders, the other holder disabled or the platform holder disabled; `holdsPlatformPermissionSet` for a name with no address follows the one platform holder (true while enabled, false while disabled, the second holder refused in both); a column-less grant of a name `crm` and `hr` hold, `hr` disabled, confers nothing, and the disabled holder's bound grant is never re-targeted (CONTROLs: each bound grant confers its own set). #32497 is not on `main` yet; when it lands, the branch merges `main` again and these pins are re-taken.
- Core `security-catalog.test.ts`, `resolve-authz-context.grant-set-by-name.test.ts`; plugin-security `security-catalog-echo.test.ts`, `packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts`, `catalog-reference-report.test.ts`; metadata `metadata-manager-cluster.test.ts`.
- **A phase-1 pin this change moves, read FROM → TO** (plugin-security `security-catalog-permission-sets-by-package.test.ts`): "a second package holding an anchor's set name is refused" installed two packages of two namespaces, which this change admits. It keeps the refusal for a package with no namespace (unchanged), and a TO row pins two namespaces' sets of the name: both held; the `everyone` anchor's environment binding of the name is refused `ambiguous-in-environment` naming both, grants nothing through it, and the rest of the anchor still grants.

## Acceptance notes

- **Row 9 is ruled: A** (6824698376, the maintainer, 2026-11-12T13:17Z): a disabled package still counts as a holder of a permission-set name for the two permission-set reads, so a disable never makes a column-less or stale-column grant confer more. This PR's row-9 pins keep that answer. #32497 carries the exception (`includeDisabledPackages: true` at those two reads). Measured on a local trial merge of this head with #32497 plus that exception (not pushed): this file's 17 pins are green, and with `hr` disabled a column-less grant of a name `crm` and `hr` hold confers nothing (it conferred `crm`'s set without the exception). That is N3 condition 3 read in the "#32497 lands first" order; the pins are re-taken on `main` whichever lands first.
- **Lands after #32718; merges `main` first.** The real-engine door pin for an organization administrator naming one of two holders (gate + seam + reader) is owed once #32718 is on `main`.
- **Merge hazard with #32497** (not yet on `main`): both edit the stored-column arm of `resolvePermissionScoped` in `packages/core/src/security/security-catalog.ts`. Whichever lands second keeps #32497's disabled-holder check ahead of this PR's metadata-slot read (a local trial merge resolved it that way and built; not pushed).
- **Two holders, a column-less grant: what says so today** (for a follow-up card, not this PR): the catalog reference boot report lists such a grant, but under "grants naming a permission set the catalog does not resolve", with no candidates and a fix that says to declare the set again; the position half of the same report does name the refusal and both candidates. `os doctor` says nothing. The fix the refusal itself names is `os migrate stored-references bind`.
- Branch: this thread's `claude/project-thread-26yakz`, resumed from `claude/project-thread-xsgo56@fddb44aa` (the claim amendment 6821966485 names xsgo56; the epic seat restates it).

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched: n/a)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. (local subset per the report; the full farm is CI's)
